text.Transit Nexus:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 3 Combat, 4 Trade and 5 Authority. Transit Nexus is a base with defense 6. 
 Strategy ==
Likely the best card in the Frontiers set. A decent 3 damage, a massive 4 Trade and a good 5 Authority each turn it stays in play. Without requiring any allies. It is not an outpost, but you can use that to your advantage: if you can put one or two outposts up to protect it, this card may survive several turns and in the meantime you can acquire lots of expensive cards, not to mention the additional Combat and Authority that this base provides. 

Conclusion: must-have for any deck. If you cannot acquire it, make sure to scrap it out of the trade row before your opponent gets it.
